name: SAii Phi Phi Island Village
zone: Loh Bagao Bay (Loh Ba Gao), Koh Phi Phi Don
type: Luxury Beachfront Resort (Thai-style bungalows + pool villas)
highlights: Secluded private 800m beach on the quiet Loh Bagao Bay side of Phi Phi Don, away from the Tonsai/Loh Dalum party crowds
Genuinely spacious, clean Thai-style bungalows set amid a coconut plantation, plus hillside villas with private splash pools and sea views
Highly praised, attentive and personable staff service noted repeatedly across Booking, Agoda and TripAdvisor
Two large swimming pools, full-service spa with skilled therapists, and five restaurants / three bars on site
On-site 5-star PADI dive centre and Marine Discovery Centre (baby sharks, clownfish breeding, reef sustainability) — family and eco friendly
Fantastic, varied breakfast and easy boat access to Maya Bay / Koh Phi Phi Leh (~45 min)
cons: Remote island location means costly, infrequent boat access — ~300 THB scheduled shared transfer or ~1,300 THB private boat each time you leave, plus pricey mainland/ferry transfers and rough seas in monsoon season
Rocky/shallow shore at low tide limits swimming from the beach at times
Food and drink pricing considered steep for Thailand; a few reports of stomach upsets
Some ageing infrastructure and upkeep lapses (dated buggies, occasional pool cleanliness/mosquitoes in hillside villas) that some felt didn't match the 5-star price
notes: Confirmed REAL and currently operating (2025-2026). Formerly 'Phi Phi Island Village Beach Resort', rebranded under S Hotels & Resorts' SAii brand; official site saiihotels.com/phiphiisland-village. 201 keys total: ~189 Thai-style bungalows/suites + 12 Hillside Pool Villas, on a private 800m stretch of Loh Bagao Bay (east/north-east side of Phi Phi Don), reached only by boat (~45-60 min from Phuket, or boat from Tonsai pier). Scores verified: Booking 8.6 (3,135+ reviews on main listing; review sub-page showed 8.6/1,138), Agoda 8.7 (~3,879 reviews), Trip.com 8.8 (265 reviews), TripAdvisor 4.3/5 (~6,397 reviews, ranked #2 of 45 on Ko Phi Phi Don). Pricing is approximate/seasonal: aggregators show lows around 4,038 THB (h-rez) to ~8,474 THB; realistic cheapest bungalow ~6,000 THB low season, pool villas ~20,000+ THB. THB room prices are estimates converted from USD listings (~$104-229/night range), not exact live rates — treat as ballpark. Agoda detail URL given is the canonical hotel page (cid to be appended later); could not fully render Agoda/Booking client-side content via WebFetch but URLs are the genuine detail pages confirmed via search result listings.

name: Phi Phi Holiday Resort

rooms.type: Ocean Sunset Pool Villa (Sunset Wing hilltop)

highlights: Sits on Laem Tong Bay, one of the quietest, cleanest white-sand beaches on Phi Phi Don, far from the Tonsai party scene, and positioned so you can catch both sunrise and sunset
Genuinely family-friendly: Kids Club plus 4 outdoor pools including two infinity pools and a dedicated kids pool
Sunset Wing hilltop pool villas deliver panoramic Andaman sea views and extra privacy
Warm, attentive staff and handy golf-buggy transport around the sprawling grounds
Strong breakfast spread and on-site dining at both beachfront and hilltop restaurants
Full resort facilities: PADI dive centre, spa, fitness, boutique and Thai cooking classes; ranked #1 hotel on Laem Tong on TripAdvisor (4.1/5, 3,330 reviews)
cons: Many rooms, especially the older garden and superior bungalows, feel dated and are widely called overpriced for the condition; several need renovation
Remote island location makes everything costly: pricey food and drinks and expensive speedboat/longtail transfers (roughly 1,500 THB by longtail) just to reach it, with no walking to Tonsai village
The beach and beachfront rooms can get busy and noisy during the day with boats and tractors, and some rooms overlook construction/back-of-house areas
Occasional service inconsistency plus food-hygiene niggles (flies at breakfast, uncovered dishes) and weak air-conditioning in a few units
notes: REBRAND: this is the property formerly called "Holiday Inn Resort Phi Phi Island" (IHG flag gone); now the independent "Phi Phi Holiday Resort" (SHA Extra Plus), official phiphiholidayresort.com. TripAdvisor listing d305924 shows "formerly known as Holiday Inn Resort Phi Phi Island", 4.1/5 ~3,330 reviews #1 on Laem Tong. The Agoda/Booking/Trip detail URLs keep the legacy holiday-inn slug but all display the current "Phi Phi Holiday Resort" name + reviews (verified). Booking 8.0/1,112, Trip 8.3/267. Cheapest ~3,000 THB low season (from ~$116 high season). The review SHOULD mention the former Holiday Inn name for recognition. Confirmed REAL and OPERATING in 2025-2026 with guest reviews dated through July 2026. Located on Laem Tong Bay (Leam Tong), the remote northeast tip of Koh Phi Phi Don, Krabi. Note the platform URL slug is "holiday-inn-resort-phi-phi-island" but the hotel is branded "Phi Phi Holiday Resort" (NOT an IHG/Holiday Inn property; the separate Holiday Inn Resort Phi Phi Island is a different hotel on Laem Tong). 162 rooms across three zones: main-wing garden/beachfront bungalows, Coral Wing sea-view studios, and Sunset Wing hilltop/ocean pool villas. Amenities verified on official site: 4 pools (family, kids, 2 infinity), Kids Club, spa, dive centre, fitness, cooking classes. Access ONLY by boat: resort-arranged speedboat from Phuket or Krabi, or longtail taxi (~1,500 THB, ~30 min); no ferry pier walk-up like Tonsai. Being on the far northeast beach, it does NOT get the Loh Dalum party noise. Scores: Booking 8.2 (~2,178 reviews; older cache showed 8.0/1,112), Agoda 8.3 (~4,555 reviews), Trip.com 8.3 (~267-304 reviews), TripAdvisor 4.1/5 (3,330 reviews), #1 of hotels on Laem Tong, 4-star. Prices are approximate/seasonal: cheapest garden bungalow around 8,900 THB/night (search cited ~9,000 THB; Planet of Hotels from ~$252, avg ~$145); pool villas and 2-bedroom family suite (141.6 sqm) run notably higher. Booking.com and Agoda detail pages returned empty/bot-blocked on direct fetch, and Trip.com detail returned HTTP 418, so scores/prices were corroborated via search-result snippets and the TripAdvisor + official-site fetches rather than reading each detail page in full. All three detail URLs are the real, verified hotel pages (confirmed via search result listings). Additional real-photo sources: TripAdvisor listing and Trip.com gallery.

name: Phi Phi Island Cabana Hotel
type: Beachfront Resort (isthmus, Tonsai Bay / Loh Dalum)
highlights: Unbeatable central location on the isthmus - roughly a 2-minute walk (~100-200m) from Tonsai Pier, so no long-tail boat transfer or luggage haul on arrival
Large outdoor pool set over Loh Dalum Bay with the postcard limestone-cliff view, widely praised as the property's standout feature
Straddles both Ton Sai and Loh Dalum bays - steps from restaurants, dive shops, ferries and the island's nightlife
Spacious rooms with private balconies and a choice of sea or garden views across six low-rise buildings on 12 acres
Extensive American/Asian breakfast buffet at Maya Restaurant plus a beachfront bar-restaurant
Friendly, helpful front-desk and staff noted repeatedly in positive reviews
cons: Rooms and bathrooms feel dated and run-down - guests report broken tiles, weak flush/water pressure and decor overdue for renovation
Party noise: beach clubs on Loh Dalum pump 'pounding beats' until ~2-3am, audible from many rooms
Recent reviews flag pest issues (rats/mice reported entering some rooms) and inconsistent cleanliness
Poor value for the asking price given the tired condition; weak/patchy WiFi and hard beds also cited
notes: CONFIRMED real and currently operating (2025-2026): TripAdvisor shows 2026 prices, 1,491 reviews, 3.3/5, ranked #22-23 of 45 hotels on Ko Phi Phi Don; Booking.com and Trip.com both list live 2025-2026 availability. A 3-star, 154-room resort spread over ~12 acres on the isthmus between Ton Sai Bay and Loh Dalum Bay, ~1.2km listed distance to Ton Sai Pier but guests describe it as a 2-minute (~100-200m) walk - a genuine perk vs boat-only Phi Phi properties. Scores verified: Booking.com 6.7/10 (299 verified reviews; sub-scores Location 9.0, Value 5.9, WiFi 5.2), Trip.com 8.1/10 (261 reviews), TripAdvisor 3.3/5 (1,491 reviews). AGODA SCORE NOT CONFIRMED - Agoda hotel/review pages would not render content via WebFetch (JS-gated) and did not surface a number in search, so scoreAgoda left blank rather than fabricated; Agoda detail URL itself was seen in search results and is valid. PRICES ARE APPROXIMATE/DERIVED: KAYAK/momondo/Expedia show cheapest from ~USD 53-58 (~1,900 THB) with average ~USD 90-102 (~3,200-3,600 THB); exact per-room-type THB not scrapeable, so the four room rows are estimated tiers (Superior garden < Deluxe sea/pool < Grand Deluxe < Family) - verify against live Agoda/Booking before publishing. Room categories confirmed to include Superior/Deluxe with sea or garden views, private balconies, AC, TV, minibar, safe, hot/cold shower; dining = Maya Restaurant (breakfast buffet 07:00-10:00) + Jungle Beach Bar & Restaurant. WARNING: phiphiisland-cabana.com resolved to a compromised/spam page (Samsung/naga2000 content) - do NOT use as official site or photo source; use TripAdvisor/Trip.com/Expedia galleries for real photos.

name: Phi Phi The Beach Resort
highlights: Spectacular elevated sea views over the Andaman to Phi Phi Leh / Maya Bay, especially from the hillside villas
Quiet, laid-back Long Beach (Hat Yao) setting away from the party chaos and noise of Tonsai/Loh Dalum
Own stretch of clear beachfront with excellent snorkelling right offshore (reef fish, blacktip reef sharks sighted)
Friendly, genuinely attentive and helpful staff repeatedly praised in recent reviews
Beachside restaurant/bar with good ambiance and generous, tasty breakfast
Villa-style private balconies plus complimentary minibar items; strong couples appeal (Booking couples score 8.9)
cons: Access only by longtail boat (~5 min, ~100 THB/person from Tonsai pier); repeated water transfers can feel tiresome and weather-dependent
Steep hillside layout — back/upper villas involve a long climb up steps from the beach (buggy service helps but not always)
Rooms and communal areas feel dated/worn; some units struggle to keep aircon cool
Mosquitoes/biting insects in the villa and garden areas, mainly late afternoon; a few reports of inconsistent restaurant food and tired maintenance
notes: CONFIRMED real and currently operating (2025-2026): official site phiphithebeach.com is live with active room categories/promos, and it holds strong recent review volume across all major OTAs (Booking 3,263 reviews, Agoda 5,087, Trip.com 224, TripAdvisor 1,972 reviews / 3.7-of-5 stars, ranked #4 of 45 Ko Phi Phi Don hotels). Zone: Long Beach / Hat Yao on Phi Phi Don — NOT the same property as the nearby 'Phi Phi Long Beach Resort & Villa'; verify you use the correct listing. Star rating ~3.5 (Agoda/TripAdvisor). Scores: Booking 8.5 (couples 8.9 — matches the known ~8.8 couples note), Agoda 8.3, Trip.com 8.6. Pricing varies sharply by season: KAYAK cheapest booked ~US$57 (~2,000 THB), Agoda 'from US$80++' (~2,800 THB), peak deluxe villas can approach US$150-200/night; room prices above are approximate. Room categories are all villa-style (Superior, Superior Partial Sea View, Sea View Deluxe, Grand Sea View Deluxe, Front Side Deluxe). Pool note: official site and OTAs describe an outdoor swimming pool; I could NOT independently verify the '3 pools' claim in the brief (only a single pool was clearly referenced) — confirm before stating three pools in the review. Views are toward Phi Phi Leh / Maya Bay, consistent with the brief. Trip.com detail page returned HTTP 418 to WebFetch but the URL is valid (hotel ID 712354). For photos, use the official site; TripAdvisor photo galleries (d638178) also have abundant real guest/hotel images.

name: PP Princess Resort
highlights: Unbeatable central Loh Dalum location — steps onto the white-sand beach (rooms within ~30m of the sand) yet only ~300m / 5-min walk from Tonsai Pier and the village, so ferry arrivals reach it easily with luggage
Widely praised for having the best beach views in Loh Dalum Bay, directly on the bay's swimming beach
Two swimming pools, one with a swim-up pool bar overlooking the beach
Friendly, helpful staff (Booking staff sub-score 8.3, the highest category)
Recently renovated deluxe rooms and pool villas — several recent guests call the rooms spotless and stunning
On-site restaurants and beach bar serving international menus and fresh island seafood; snorkelling/Maya Bay longtail trips and kayak rental arranged on-site
cons: Heavy late-night party noise — the resort sits right beside Loh Dalum's beach clubs (e.g. Slinky's) plus its own pool bar; multiple guests say it is very hard to sleep before ~2am and describe rave-level music
Room quality is inconsistent: some guests report dated rooms, very hard beds, and cleanliness lapses despite the renovation
Below-average value for money for the price (Booking value sub-score ~7.1) — island pricing, plus a THB 2,000 cash damage deposit on arrival
Service gaps noted in reviews: no room service and breakfast complaints
notes: Confirmed REAL and currently operating (2025-2026) on Koh Phi Phi Don, in the middle of Loh Dalum Bay, Krabi. Verified across Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com, TripAdvisor, Phuket101 and the official ppprincess.com. 4-star; 67 rooms over two floors (Deluxe Rooms, Deluxe/Pool Villas, Private Pool Villas incl. two-storey pool villas); 2 pools one with swim-up bar — all matches the known context. Scores: Booking 7.5 ("good", ~1,695 reviews; Location 9.1, Staff 8.3, Value 7.1); Trip.com 8.2 (~146 reviews); TripAdvisor 3/5, ranked ~#17 of 45 on Phi Phi Don. Agoda numeric score not captured (page rendered JS-only via WebFetch/HTTP 418 on some detail pages) — left blank rather than guessed. Prices are APPROXIMATE THB estimates converted from USD aggregator data (KAYAK/MakeMyTrip showed roughly $100-146 cheapest; separate "PP Princess Pool Villa" listing quoted from ~$300) — treat room-type THB figures as ballpark, not scraped exact rates. Tonsai Pier ~300m; no separate ferry transfer needed (walk from pier). Key island caveat is the party noise from Loh Dalum beach clubs + the resort's own pool bar. Alternate Agoda URL also seen: https://www.agoda.com/pp-princess-resort-h78656995/hotel/ko-phi-phi-th.html

name: Phi Phi Bayview & Premier Resort
zone: Laem Hin Beach (Tonsai Bay east), Koh Phi Phi Don

rooms.type: Grand Deluxe / Premier Deluxe Sea View

highlights: Elevated private balconies with genuinely stunning views over Tonsai Bay, the Andaman Sea and the surrounding karst cliffs — the resort's signature selling point
Sits on its own quiet Laem Hin beach on the eastern side of Tonsai, insulated from the Loh Dalum party noise while still ~10 min walk to town
Free boat transfer between the main Tonsai pier and the resort, so you skip dragging luggage through the village
Consistently friendly and helpful reception/staff noted across recent reviews
Among the largest family rooms on the island, plus a swimming pool with jacuzzi and beachfront 'The Bay' restaurant
Peaceful, jungle-hillside setting good for couples and families wanting relaxation with island access
cons: Rooms and facilities are dated and unevenly maintained — recent guests report cockroaches, wall/ceiling holes, weak water pressure and unreliable hot water
Steep hillside with many steps and slopes; tiring and unsuitable for anyone with mobility issues or heavy luggage
Beach/boat access is tide- and sea-dependent — arrival can involve wading, and the swim beach is modest
Complaints of poor value for the price plus reported pressure for extra cash payment or a card surcharge at checkout
notes: CONFIRMED real and currently operating on Koh Phi Phi Don — recent 2026 guest reviews exist. Address: 69 Moo 7, Laem Hin Beach, Tonsai Bay, Phi Phi Island, Krabi 81000. Formerly / still branded 'Arayaburi Resort' (that name appears in Booking/Trip.com URL slugs and is the same property under same ownership). Note there is a SEPARATE but related property, 'Bayview Resort Phi Phi Island – Beach Front Resort' (Booking slug bay-view-resort, Trip.com 712273) — same owners, shares pool/restaurant; do NOT conflate its scores/reviews with this hillside Premier resort. Two wings: Phi Phi Bayview Wing (Superior/Deluxe/Grand Deluxe/Family) and Phi Phi Premier Wing (Premier Deluxe/Grand/Family). SCORES: KAYAK aggregator (matching the 69 Moo 7 Laem Hin address) shows Booking.com 6.7/10 (858 reviews) and Agoda 7.2/10 (109 reviews); TripAdvisor 3.3/5 from 2,522 reviews (ranked #21 of 45 on Phi Phi Don). Traveloka displays a higher 8.7/10 — treat as outlier / smaller sample; the Booking 6.7 + TripAdvisor 3.3 are more representative of the 'dated but great-view' consensus. Trip.com score not confirmable (page returned 418/blocked) so scoreTrip left blank rather than guessed. PRICE: cheapest ~$37/night (~1,300 THB) low season for a basic Superior; Premier/family rooms roughly 2,800–3,400 THB; all room THB figures are approximate. Operational note: Traveloka listing flagged the pool closed 1–31 May 2026 (seasonal maintenance) — worth verifying at time of publish. Free boat transfer from pier confirmed on official site. Agoda/Booking/Trip.com detail pages could not be scraped directly (bot-blocked/418/403), but the URLs above are the genuine detail pages surfaced in search, not search-result pages. Official photo source: phiphibayviews.com (also facilities.php). starRating=3 confirmed by TripAdvisor and Trip.com.

name: Viking Nature Resort
zone: Loh Moo Dee (own near-private beach between Tonsai Bay and Long Beach/Hat Yao, eastern Phi Phi Don)

rooms.type: Deluxe / larger fan bungalow with sea or garden view
Large family bungalow (multi-bedroom, sleeps up to ~10)

highlights: Its own secluded, near-private snorkeling beach tucked in the jungle at Loh Moo Dee — swim and snorkel straight off the sand
Genuinely unique hand-built wooden bungalows and treehouses, each individually decorated, set among trees with sea views
Outstanding value: TripAdvisor #1 of 102 specialty lodgings on Phi Phi Don and consistently rated a best-value budget resort
Free longtail boat transfer from Ton Sai Pier, plus a walkable path (~15-20 min) to town and to Long Beach
Quiet, private and nature-immersed — well away from the Loh Dalum party noise, great for couples and families wanting calm
Friendly, helpful staff and a solid on-site Thai/seafood restaurant, with massage/spa on location
cons: Many rooms are fan-only with no air-conditioning, so they can get hot and humid (confirm A/C when booking)
Steep steps and uneven jungle pathways throughout — hard going for anyone with mobility issues and awkward with luggage
Mosquitoes/insects in the jungle setting — bring repellent
Rustic and some rooms dated/basic, with variable water pressure and hot water; access mainly via longtail boat or the rocky walking path
notes: CONFIRMED real and currently operating (2025-2026 listings live and taking bookings on Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com, Expedia, Hotels.com). Location: on the eastern side of Phi Phi Don, on its own small near-private beach at Loh Moo Dee, described across sources as 'between Ton Sai Beach and Long Beach', a 5-min walk from Long Beach (Hat Yao) and ~15-25 min walk / short longtail ride from Ton Sai Pier. ~56 rooms. Verified scores: Booking.com 8.9/10 (4,141 verified reviews); Agoda 8.5/10 (~3,333 reviews); Trip.com 9.1/10 (112 reviews); TripAdvisor 3.8/5, ranked #1 of 102 specialty lodging on Ko Phi Phi Don (1,948 reviews). Star rating: 3-star. Prices approximate and seasonal — cheapest fan rooms seen around USD 29-39 (~1,000-1,400 THB); THB room figures above are estimates converted from listed USD/typical seasonal ranges, not exact quoted rates. A refundable deposit of ~500 THB/room is charged on arrival. Fan-only is the norm; some A/C units exist — verify per room type. Photos: official site vikingnaturesresort.com has real property/treehouse photos; TripAdvisor Hotel_Review page and Trip.com detail page also have genuine guest and property galleries. Did NOT reach an exact live per-room price table (Booking/Agoda/Trip detail pages blocked live fetch); all numeric prices are informed estimates, all scores/review counts are from search-surfaced source data.

name: Paradise Pearl Bungalows

rooms.type: Beachfront Bungalow (P1–P3, teak, direct sea view)

highlights: Genuinely beachfront on Long Beach (Hat Yao) — bungalows sit steps from the sand facing the reef, with clear views across to Phi Phi Leh
Rated one of the best beaches on the island for swimming and snorkeling: real drop-off, waves, and a reef reachable straight off the shore
Peaceful, low-key location well away from the Tonsai/Loh Dalum party noise — favored by couples and travelers wanting to relax
Original teak Thai-style bungalows have real character and authenticity; the newer freestanding bungalows are the standout pick
On-site beachfront restaurant and bar praised for food and cocktails; breakfast and minimart on site
Complimentary long-tail boat transfer offered in high season, plus long-tail access to Tonsai village avoids the long walk
cons: Older 'room' buildings (as opposed to the freestanding bungalows) are dated — worn linens, thin bedding, tired bathrooms and doors with gaps; several guests report insects/mosquitoes

Access is only by long-tail boat or a 20-minute rocky walk from Tonsai village; the hotel does NOT keep staff or boats standing by at the pier (transfer needs advance notice), and taxi-boat fares are sometimes inflated
Service is polarizing — many praise the manager and reception, but recurring complaints about unfriendly/phone-focused restaurant staff and being pushed to leave the restaurant by ~9:30–10pm
Not suitable for elderly or mobility-limited guests due to the boat transfers and beach access; low-season maintenance (beach trash, less frequent cleaning) draws criticism
notes: CONFIRMED real and operating in 2025–2026 on Long Beach (Hat Yao), Koh Phi Phi Don, Krabi. Verified across Booking.com (score 8.9), TripAdvisor (#5 of 45 on Ko Phi Phi Don, 3.7/5 from ~1,056 reviews), Trip.com (8.8/10, "Location" sub-score ~9.5), and its official site phiphiparadisepearl.com. ~41–47 units; 3-star. Original Thai wooden beachfront bungalows in front of the island's best snorkeling reef — the context provided checks out. Could not read an exact live Agoda score (Agoda page rendered JS-only), so scoreAgoda left blank; the Agoda detail URL is confirmed live. Note one data caveat: one Trip.com regional page showed 7.9 while the main review page showed 8.8 — used 8.8 (matches larger review base). Pricing is approximate: KAYAK advertises "from ~$41" (~THB 1,450) low-season for basic rooms; beachfront teak bungalows run much higher (recent booked rates ~$86–$124 = ~THB 3,000–4,400+), so priceFromTHB≈1,500 reflects cheapest garden room, not the beachfront bungalows the property is known for. Key island-specific fact for the review: official site explicitly states NO boat/staff standby at the pier — transfers require advance notice; high-season (Nov 1–Apr 30) free long-tail pickup from Tonsai Pier on request. Official photos of the beachfront bungalows are at the photoSourceUrl and phiphiparadisepearl.com galleries; TripAdvisor also hosts many real guest photos. All URLs above were actually retrieved, not fabricated.
